notes.title: Updates 🩸🪦
notes.content:
🌈Happy Pride Month!🌈

Love is love, regardless of gender. We're so happy to be working on a LGBTQ+ dating sim where people can express themselves. In Drops of Death, players can choose their pronouns (He/Him) (She/Her) (They/Them) and also decide between two appearances. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38618055/58d182323859d2f9cd13622ea723df4c0bedc87e.png

Before we dive in, we also want to celebrate that we are rapidly approaching 10k wishlists. Thank you all for supporting Drops of Death! We are steadily making progress on the game, so here's a little update on what we have accomplished.

💔💀We've just finished scripting Edwin's Route💔
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38618055/9c8154536725d09132339dc34e3b54e1f2dd9573.png

💔💀We've started scripting Fawn's Route💔
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38618055/ec422735aea8f756adde86ea7a7364f2101b5dae.png

🎵Both Edwin's and Fawn's soundtrack creation has begun🎵
While we aren't going to share what we've made so far, just know that it sounds awesome! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38618055/093acdacb9f23c07b0dab9bf47b6e6edc866559d.png

🔍We completed all of the evidence icons🔍
The evidence system allows players to collect evidence to uncover who the killer is. We've successfully completed the artwork for all of these collectables!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38618055/6938357b0a41c06953df062b7a759ca740a5fc85.png

That's all for now, thank you for reading!

notes.title: Drops of Death Coming to Kickstarter!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38618055/51c66b62356451b777ae7cf8aa14abe043ef05b9.png

We just announced that Drops of Death will be coming to Kickstarter. You can follow the Kickstarter pre-launch page by clicking here  so you can get notified once the Kickstarter goes live.

Why are we doing a Kickstarter?

We are on track to release the game in October of 2025, but we'll be launching a Kickstarter in order to enhance the game. 

Some of the things we hope to achieve through this campaign:

🎵More music for the soundtrack
🎙️Voice Acting
🎨More CGs of your favorite love interests/suspects!

Plus, we've got some KILLER merch planned for the campaign. 

You can also follow us on Tiktok to stay updated with fun Drops of Death content!

- The Snowhaven Studios Team

notes.title: Our Next Game Just Dropped!
notes.content:
A few months ago, we announced our killer dating sim, Drops of Death, and today we're releasing Love's Crescendo, our cozy sapphic romance visual novel. Our team has a love for making games with a dark twist😈... yet we also enjoy creating wholesome stories too💕.

Now that Love's Crescendo is finally released, we're going to be focusing on Drops of Death development moving forward.

We thank you for supporting our small indie team in any way you can, consider buying Love's Crescendo or sharing it on social media!

📣Today is the launch day for Love's Crescendo 📣
We're pleased to present our latest game, Love's Crescendo, a cozy rhythm game visual novel about finding true love and reigniting that spark for your passions. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38618055/be55528878e2c511409736b85a248ffc6f85b303.png

🎹 Play Rhythm Games with an Original Soundtrack 🎹
Love's Crescendo features 10 magnificent, original songs by our composers. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38618055/3e2c9090cf7d55a04cb3b7003afcb0848f1e5128.png

💿 Jukebox 💿
Love's Crescendo has replay value! Play the rhythm games outside of the story via the jukebox for an unlimited amount of fun~
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38618055/5ab019625b4f4731ee3059c394305acdeb713f07.jpg

💕31,000+ words of wholesome sapphic romance 💕 
Our story features two lovely ladies as they fall in love, both with their music and with each other. <3
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38618055/471799cadf662708a9d2cef60e39fce4b2d9cb08.png

🎨8 Vibrant CGs🎨
We have 8 CGs that perfectly capture the moments in the story.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38618055/3fa213eab2eef3cb2e2c66ee28de8e8bd7ac2550.png

☕ A cozy gaming experience ☕
Overall, we wanted Love's Crescendo to be a cozy gaming experience where players can enjoy a non-competitive rhythm game alongside a heartwarming story. If you're looking for a rhythm game that's low-stress, this one is perfect for you. It's okay if you don't get perfect scores, it won't affect the outcome of the story!

[previewyoutube=XYjicnrOpbo;full][image: KISS GIF][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for reading!~

notes.title: New Steam Page!
notes.content:
Hi Drops of Death fans, we have news for you! 

First of all, we updated our Steam page that now features the new art, updated character descriptions, and the trailer we made for the game. We also wanted to share that we started working on the demo too! Are you excited for the thrill of possibly dating the killer?

Get to know the four love interests (and possible killers):


Fawn: The Lively, Unsuspecting True Crime Blogger 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38618055/bc4e5e68965f17df2734031b8abebd212bcc07a8.png

Fawn is an energetic and knowledgeable detective who runs her own true crime blog called Fawning for Crime. Though she can be annoying (especially to Detective Singh), she loves talking about a killer’s motive and unsolved cases. Some may say her passion for crime is a bit…unhinged.

Natasha: The Quiet One
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38618055/9a4c6d556f2801e29f74118df116a29be8e12a5a.png
Natasha is a quiet college student who was on the school’s swim team until she was advised to leave for unknown reasons. The experience she had with her teammates wasn’t pleasant and led to her being distant and at arm's length with others—except her older brother, Anton.

Singh: The Detective
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38618055/a20c1fa7c696547f8da77e131bb0d9c57ac902cf.png
Nick Singh is a young homicide detective in charge of leading the murder investigation. Growing up he always wanted to be a detective, and eventually he started his career in his hometown, but was relocated to this smaller suburb. Up until now, he’s been forced to do paperwork and small, uninteresting cases.

Edwin: The Best Friend
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38618055/a184704d9407ecab600cb9d70b184d261f63f6e3.png
Edwin is Adrien’s best friend and a fellow marketing major, who is part of an active campus fraternity. He can be very protective of Adrien’s well-being and has walked them home to ensure their safety a number of times. However, Edwin has shown extreme bouts of jealousy when Adrien displays the slightest interest in others.

Which one of these love interests would you like to date?

You can check out the Steam page for more information, and be on the lookout for a demo in the future!
